name: script_dialog_hold
about: A dialogue holds an NPC. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::InputStartPlayerDialog 0x1029ef80 (datamap 0x105ce470): with the player present, the player's dialogue handle +0xfe8 empty and flags2 & 0x10000000 clear, FinishTalking, think reset, and a forced install of SCHED_TROIKA_START_PLAYER_DIALOG 0x6d (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_start_player_dialog.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE, STOP_MOVING, STORE_POSITION_IN_SAVEPOSITION, SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE DIST:DIALOG, GET_PATH_TO_PLAYER_FOR_DIALOG, SET_NPC_FLAG FORCE_RELAXED_ANIMS, WALK_RUN_PATH_FOR_DIALOG, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, START_PLAYER_DIALOG, RUN_DIALOG; no interrupts); TASK_RUN_DIALOG 0x6a then holds the NPC (m_hDialogPartner) for as long as the dialogue stands: no other program is selected. sp_tutorial_1's Hunter1 (npc_VHumanCombatant, dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg, D_LI 0, use_interesting 0) verbatim; the wire is the corpus's own form (Zhao StartPlayerDialog '' on ch_zhaos_1).
known_red: new: StartPlayerDialog installs no SCHED_TROIKA_START_PLAYER_DIALOG; the dialogue opens at the input with OnDialogBegin
notes: The release half (the dialogue closing, CDialog::Release, the NPC selecting again) is not expressed: the harness has no action that answers or closes a dialogue as the player does (EndDialog is a port-only seam with no retail datamap record). Harness gap, listed in triage-W.md.
